name: Turn one product photo into a 2x2 or 3x3 sheet of ad concepts
tagline: Make a contact sheet of marketplace ad shots from a single product photo
description: Product Grid AI is built for small online sellers who need several advertising images from a single product photo. Upload the photo, choose a 2x2 or 3x3 grid and one of three art directions (Soft studio, Botanical or Bold geometry), and get a contact sheet of ad concepts. Download as PNG or ZIP; a free image splitter cuts any sheet into separate images. Pricing is $1 per sheet, one-time, no subscription.
